concept: The cover now leads with MI's own teaser: the bronze hand and cap cut out of its white background and set on the Krayon dark canvas with a warm glow, so it reads as our post, not a repost. The answer line sits under it in white ('MI still have no captain.'), with a credit to Mumbai Indians on X. Slide 2 explains why the armband is empty (Hardik traded to Punjab Kings). Slide 3 is one giant '5', the reason every fan read the post the same way. The last slide lists the reported options and hands the vote to the comments, with a clear line that nothing is confirmed. Cricket blue. The reel stays type-only.
caption:
No caption. Just a hand holding the MI cap.

That is all Mumbai Indians posted on X on Wednesday. Fans had a name ready within minutes: Rohit Sharma.

Why the guessing? MI have no captain for IPL 2027. Hardik Pandya, who led them from 2024, has been traded to Punjab Kings with Arshdeep Singh moving to Mumbai.

Rohit led MI for 11 seasons and won five titles: 2013, 2015, 2017, 2019 and 2020. Suryakumar Yadav, Jasprit Bumrah and Tilak Varma have also been named in reports as options.

MI have not confirmed anything yet. So we are asking you.

Who should captain Mumbai Indians in 2027? Tell us below.
